description.value: The study reports the clinical, volumetric MRI, neuropathological and genetic features of a new chromosome 9p-linked FTD-ALS family, comparing structural MRI volumes in affected VSM-20 family members with sporadic bvFTD cases and normal controls.

spans.text: The authors report the clinical, volumetric MRI, neuropathological and genetic features of a new chromosome 9p-linked FTD-ALS family, VSM-20.

description.value: A familial observational study compared affected VSM-20 family members with sporadic bvFTD cases and normal control subjects using structural MRI and volumetric analysis.

spans.text: Lobar brain volumes were derived in five affected family members (four predominantly bvFTD (II-8, III-2, III-3, and III-15), one predominantly ALS (III-9)) as compared with 10 sporadic bvFTD cases, matched for CDR-SB scores to the family members, and 13 normal control subjects.

value: Cortical volumes were reduced in the VSM-20 family members and the sporadic bvFTD group as compared with controls.

Whereas both groups displayed bilateral frontal lobe atrophy as compared with controls, only the sporadic bvFTD displayed temporal lobe atrophy. In contrast, only the VSM-20 family members displayed subtle parietal and right occipital lobe atrophy as compared with controls.
